groups.second: 630 frozen eligible crypto altcoins; gold reported gross separately

first_touch: First post-complete-Monday directional1618 touch per NY week; crypto weekly prefix must be uninterrupted. No new wick-only/body/volume filter.
short_rule: At or after touch, completed5m close crosses from >=previousSMA50 to <currentSMA50. A later bar high>=its completedSMA50 and close<SMA50 confirms rejection. If a close returns to the wrong side, wait for a fresh cross. Enter at first confirmation close; long mirrored.
entry: Market at completed confirmation close, taker fee; zero modeled latency/slippage, not a guaranteed obtainable live price
stop: Original first-touch5m high forshort, low forlong; fixed afterentry, no extra buffer
target: Opposite Monday edge: Mondaylow forshort, Mondayhigh forlong; full resting limit
monitor_expiry: Next NY Monday00:00 exclusive for new entry. Source gaps/conflict boundaries stop monitoring. No re-arm within the same week/direction after first confirmed candidate, even if geometry is invalid.
position_expiry: No time stop. Source end/unexpected crypto gap or gold quality boundary is censored; native boundary settlement is not an economic close or winner/loss.
protection: Fixed SL andTP only; no breakeven, partial exit, trailing, momentum-strength or volume filter
fee_scope: Owner-recorded current OKXLv1 scenario on Binance candles; entry andSL/censor settlement taker, restingTP maker; per-fill actual notionals
gold: Existing corrected-NY-clock HistData M1 sources aggregated5m; bid-only gross results, unknown spread/fees; no synthetic volume
